decisions_this_session.decision: Continuous /joint_commands publishing at 50 Hz between goals
decisions_this_session.rationale: Eliminates 'release jerk' at trajectory start: silent-bus periods caused STS3215 firmware to enter quiescent static-hold; goal-accept then triggered hold->motion firmware transition that briefly dropped support torque. Continuous publish keeps firmware out of that quiescent state. Verified empirically.

decisions_this_session.decision: SyncWritePosEx (Feetech instruction 0x83) replacing per-joint sequential WRITE_DATA
decisions_this_session.rationale: Original loop had ~12 ms cumulative bus skew across 6 joints — exactly the window where gravity coupling shows up at trajectory start. Single broadcast packet eliminates skew. Set Goal_Acc=254, Goal_Speed=3400 (firmware max) so each tick is treated as 'go now.'

decisions_this_session.decision: Wire freeze on _play() exit (success or tolerance-violated abort)
decisions_this_session.rationale: Without freeze, integrator keeps accumulating cmd shift post-trajectory at ~0.5°/sec; ~1 sec later cumulative shift crosses servo firmware deadband (0.88°) and arm lurches in 1° LSB-snap 'ticks.' Empirically observed and plotted. Freeze stops drift before deadband crossing. Trade-off: ~3° static residual at hold accepted as platform spec.

decisions_this_session.decision: Predictive r_hat(q) learner DISABLED by default
decisions_this_session.rationale: Architecturally sound idea (per-joint K_res learned from converged hold residuals, used as cmd = q - ff + r_hat(q) for trajectory-aware correction). Implementation has critical signal-path bugs identified by GPT v3 review: (1) i_term decoupled from plant after replacing with r_hat → label is open-loop accumulator drift, not converged correction effort; (2) per-execute learner runs twice on concurrent arm+gripper goals; (3) NLMS regularization advertised in comments not implemented; (4) sample timing misaligned (tau_g snapshotted at t_end, i_term read at next goal-accept); (5) single-sample per-joint LMS too brittle. Code retained as scaffolding for offline-calibration follow-up. Online learner cannot be safely re-enabled without redesigning the signal path.

decisions_this_session.decision: Match _i_deadband to firmware reality (1° vs original 0.3°)
decisions_this_session.rationale: STS3215 firmware deadband ~0.88°. Demanding integrator correction below this guarantees the integrator winds up against errors the hardware cannot honor → wire drift → LSB lurches. 1° matches platform floor.

decisions_this_session.decision: Reject tightening tolerance to 1° + extending completion-wait to 4s
decisions_this_session.rationale: Tested empirically; tolerance_violated aborts proliferated AND post-abort drift was actually worse (longer integrator wind-up before _play exit). Reverted to 3°/2s + freeze instead.
